column1: # GLSL shaders the Eclipse engine puts together at run time (the Mac host's DM_GL_CAPTURE, booting to the title screen): GLSL ES 1.00 (#version 100), in no game file;
# <key>.vert / <key>.frag, key = sha256(GLSL)[:16]. The NSP script's GL shader capture runs until every one here is captured; gl_shaders.py translates the capture.
# The Arcade menu and a fight in Street Fighter (1987) used no others (the GL layer made 3 pipelines in all)
